policy: V21 adds append-only accounting recovery for a MetaPay distribution settlement that was previously SETTLED/accounted and later externally REVERSED/COMPENSATED. Original distribution receipt, utilization, authorization and ledger entry remain immutable; reversal creates a new opposite signed-capital entry and never revives consumed authorization.

additions.authority_note: Append-only MetaPay evidence that one previously SETTLED reconciled beneficiary distribution was later externally COMPENSATED. Exact original receipt economics are rebound; authorization remains consumed; V1 permits zero payer-borne reversal fee only.

Financial OS decision requiring proof that the original distribution was actually posted in ReportingLedger and that a MetaPay-authoritative reversal refers to one originally SETTLED receipt. Canonical recovery is EXTERNAL_CAPITAL inflow reversal, excluded from realized P&L.
